}}'''Tinna''' is a [[Dragonsworn]] [[channeler]] who became their leader during the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Tinna}}

==Appearance==

Tinna is statuesque, has the bearing of a lady, the build of an [[Aiel]] and the color of a [[Saldaean]].{{ref/book|14|37}} She is quite pretty and has long brown hair that curls and she wears in a tail. She seems to be fairly young but this can be caused by her channeling abilities.

==Strength and Abilities==
Tinna strength in ''[[saidar]]'' is unknown. Due of her dialogue with [[Teslyn Baradon]] it can be either that she was sent away from the [[White Tower|Tower]] because of her weakness or instead because she failed one of the two tests to become [[Accepted]] or full sister (as [[Reanne Corly]] and [[Sumeko Karistovan]] did, despite being strong).

It is not usual until the [[schism]] that [[novices]] or Accepted know how to [[link]] in a [[circle]], but Tinna knows this technique. Maybe it was taught to her and to other Dragonsworn by Teslyn, in preparation of the [[Last Battle]].

==History==
The age and nationality of Tinna are unknown although her complexion and somatic characteristics may indicate that she is from Saldaea. Teslyn speaks to Tinna as if she was for a while in the White Tower and later sent away. This is confirmed by the WoTC where it is stated that she was turned out of the Tower for complicated reasons she was unwilling to share.

==Activities==

Tinna commands a group of Dragonsworn during the Last Battle in [[Merrilor]]. On orders of Teslyn she gathers more female channelers to make a circle and weave a huge [[gateway]] to the [[Polov Heights]] for the army that Mat is regrouping.

It is presumed she survived the conflict.

== Trivia ==
* Tinna is named for Tina Wagner, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
